name: MRP declaration
description: Maximum Retail Price should be visible on the package.

name: Net quantity declaration
description: Net quantity should be visible with a unit such as g, kg, ml, or L.

name: Manufacturer or packer
description: Manufacturer, packer, or importer identity and address should be visible.

name: Date information
description: Manufacturing, packing, or best-before date information should be visible where applicable.

name: Consumer care information
description: A consumer care phone number, email, or contact address should be visible.
